name: propagate distances along each axis in turn
mechanism: compute for every grid cell its distance to the nearest marked cell by handling one axis at a time: a pass along rows gives the nearest marked cell within each row, then a pass along columns combines those row results (as a lower envelope of parabolas) into true distances; each pass is linear

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Euclidean distance transform' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry: computes the distance between every point in a grid and a discrete collection of points.

requires: a separable distance (sum of per-axis terms)
